title: Windows-First Tester Package
purpose: Ship a reliable packaged loop for external testers: guided setup, dependency detection, fixtures, start/stop, browser launch, backup/restore, uninstall, and clean-environment acceptance
problem: First-run still requires cloning, Node, Ollama, ports, config, and architecture literacy. Clean-machine path is not validated as a product experience.

included: Windows-first portable or scripted release path
Guided setup with Node/Ollama detection and recommended model selection
Built-in fixtures and start/stop server controls
Automatic browser launch to Golden Path
Backup and restore + configuration migration notes
Clean-environment acceptance test (extend scripts/accept* if present)
README first-five-minutes path: Run your first local capability workflow
excluded: Full Tauri/Electron polish contest (optional thin wrapper only if needed)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Documented Windows guided setup detects Node/Ollama and starts Locaily without manual port/config editing for default path
Start path opens browser to Golden Path / Home automatically or with one confirmed click
Clean-environment acceptance test exists and passes on a documented profile
Backup/restore instructions or script cover config and local data needed to re-run demo
README states and path supports target: useful first output under 10 minutes on prepared Windows machine
